name: Phase 2 — Management & Events
objective: Build event management, announcements/CMS, scholarship management, attendance tracking, admin dashboard expansion, and audit log UI for the ISDB-BISEW Connect platform.
exit_criteria: Events can be created, listed, viewed, registered for with QR codes
Announcements and notices are manageable from admin panel
Scholarship programs, batches, and institutions are manageable
Attendance can be tracked via QR scan with batch-wise reports
Admin dashboard shows engagement graphs, event stats, batch performance
Audit log is searchable and filterable with better UX
